export_evidence: ImportKey (importkey.com/countries/india/ykk-india-pvt-ltd), US customs export records table, 5 rows actually displayed: "2022-05-14 | YKK INDIA PVT LTD. | YKK PAKISTAN (PVT) LTD. | SLIDE FASTENERS AND PARTS THERE OF ZIPPER PARTS -SLIDER | Pipavab, India | Karachi, Pakistan | 840316 | DEL300871200W"; further rows 2021-11-07 (BOL DEL900907200W), 2021-10-18 (DEL900710300W), 2020-11-05 (DEL200207300W), 2020-10-23 (DEL200871300W) — same product, same origin/destination. Source counter: page claims "Shipments available for YKK INDIA PVT LTD., refreshed daily" and a buyer block showing "21" shipments to YKK PAKISTAN (PVT) LTD.; only 5 dated rows were visible without login, so 5 of 21 claimed rows seen.
domestic_evidence: No verifiable domestic-supply record obtained. Zaubacorp and TheCompanyCheck pages for the entity returned HTTP 403 (blocked), so GST turnover band and annual-report India split could not be read; web_search backend was down (connection refused) for the whole session, so GeM/CPPP tender records could not be located. Registered address visible on ImportKey: "GLOBAL BUSINESS PARK,3RD FLOOR,TOWER- A, MEHRAULI GURGAON ROAD,GURGAON- 122002, HARYANA , INDIA" — address only, not supply evidence.
note: Export side is factually confirmed: dated bills of lading with HS 840316 (slide fasteners / zipper parts-sliders) shipped Pipavav, India -> Karachi, Pakistan, consignee YKK PAKISTAN (PVT) LTD., 2020-2022. Note the declared HS in the batch is 960711 (slide fasteners with metal teeth); the customs records show 840316 for the slider parts line — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground, the actual code should be corrected to the factual one and the verdict kept as accepted with HS correction. Domestic supply: no evidence found either way — status unknown, not 'none_found', because the registries were blocked rather than empty. Revenue and export volume: null — ImportKey free view gives no values, only counts, and the 21-shipment figure is a platform counter, not an audited volume. No CIN/PAN confirmed (registry pages inaccessible).
